data.name: Rachel
data.gender_notes: Rachel is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Raḥel, 'ewe'. Its root is Hebrew r-ḥ-l. Rachel, wife of Jacob (Genesis 29). Rachel is a Hebrew name meaning “Ewe (a female sheep)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rachel expresses “Ewe (a female sheep)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rachel total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
